text: News & Events News & Analysis Press Resources Press Resources Everything you need to cover the CHERI Alliance and CHERI technology. The CHERI Alliance is the global industry-led organisation working to accelerate the adoption of CHERI technology and advance memory-safe, secure-by-design computing. This page provides journalists, analysts, event organisers, and media partners with access to official information, background materials, and media assets. If you are covering CHERI technology, memory safety, cybersecurity, or the activities of the CHERI Alliance, you will find key resources below. Media enquiries For interview requests, expert commentary, speaking opportunities, or additional information, please contact the CHERI Alliance team. We can help with: Background on CHERI technology and memory safety Industry adoption and deployment activities CHERI Alliance initiatives and working groups Expert perspectives on secure-by-design development Commentary on cybersecurity and memory safety trends Resources for the media The following resources are available to support accurate reporting and coverage: CHERI Alliance introduction Logos and brand assets Leadership biographies and photographs Event information and media materials Technical background on CHERI technology Fact sheets and key messaging Press releases and announcements Please contact us to be added to our media announcements mailing list. For regular announcements, and news, follow us on LinkedIn or subscribe to our quarterly newsletter. About the CHERI Alliance The CHERI Alliance is a non-profit organisation that brings together industry, government, academia, and the open-source community to accelerate the development and adoption of the open CHERI cybersecurity technology. By improving memory safety and strengthening software isolation, CHERI helps organisations build more secure, resilient, and trustworthy digital systems.
